## Roadmap heartbeat joins routines/: a fresh session per fire, never the coordinator's

The roadmap report routine, the one routine every autonomous run creates, did not follow the routine standard of
0.27.0. Its template told the setup thread to bind it to the coordinator's session first. Measured on adopting
projects, an hourly routine bound there re-read the coordinator's history on every fire: about 145k tokens and ~$1.70
per fire, ~$40 a day around the clock, and growing.

- **`routines/roadmap-heartbeat.md`** is the new home of the template, listed in `routines/README.md` and checked by
  the release gate. It always runs with `create_new_session_on_fire`: it reads the repository and the forge, computes
  the facts (X of N, the startable set, READY threads, threads to nudge, open `owner-word` issues), sends them to the
  coordinator's session in one message and ends. The coordinator posts the report and runs the heartbeat.
- **Issue mode** (`autonomy.source: "issues"`) is covered in the same file: the heartbeat lists new open issues, and
  the coordinator starts one thread per well-founded issue.
- **Lifetime:** created at the start of a run, deleted when the roadmap is archived, on "stop" or "pause", or in
  issue mode after `autonomy.reports.idleHours` (new, default 24) hours with an empty queue; `idleHours: null` keeps
  it for a standing issue queue.
- **Hard rules** as in package updates: never release, tag, publish or deploy; change nothing; write to no dashboard
  or artifact; never disable or edit itself; rely on the repository.
- The managed block's "Roadmap reports" paragraph, `softure-worktree-manager` and `WORKFLOW.md` point at the new
  file. `softure-worktree-manager/references/report-routine.md` keeps a one-line pointer.
- **Release gate:** fails when a shipped file tells a coordinator to bind a routine to its own session, and when a
  routine lacks "Never disable, edit or delete this routine".

Adopting projects: a running roadmap report routine bound to the coordinator's session should be deleted and
re-created from `routines/roadmap-heartbeat.md` at the start of the next run.
